newsitem.title: USA: HP unveils new Pentium-based computers.
newsitem.headline: HP unveils new Pentium-based computers.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co on Monday unveiled computer servers in its "Pro" series centered around Intel Corp's fast Pentium microprocessors.

The most powerful, the HP NetServer LX Pro 6/200 server, will be shipped September 1. The system supports up to four 200MHz Pentium Pro processors. It is expandable to up to 2GB of error checking and correcting memory and has 17 storage bays.
Pricing for the HP NetServer LX 6/200 server with one processor and 64MB memory starts at about $13,800.
The midrange HP NetServer LXe Pro is new to the series and fully expandable to an HP NetServer LX Pro server. It supports up to four Pentium Pro processors with 2GB of RAM.
Pricing for the Model 1 with a 166MHz Pentium Pro processor and 64MB RAM starts at about $10,900.
HP also is shipping a midrange Pentium Pro-based NetServer LH Pro system. Its base model with one processor and 32MB memory starts at around $7,800.
